rules: No additional, split, replacement or expanded milestone without explicit owner approval recorded with scope/effort/progress impact.
New defects or additional work, even when related to an existing milestone, must be reported before implementation; do not hide scope growth inside an existing milestone.
One reference/evidence comparison pass and one bounded correction pass per milestone; if more work is required, stop affected work and request approval for the extension.
Completion requires all listed acceptance items and applicable standards, regression/build and visual evidence. Blocked/partial/failed is not complete.
Reuse valid prior evidence. No repeated full suites or screenshots without code changes, failures or a concrete unresolved criterion.
Owner-approved one milestone at a time, M01–M12 in order; no invented F checkpoints or unapproved scope extensions.
